plugin.name: NCMLyricsBar NetEase Lyrics
plugin.description: Synchronized bilingual NetEase lyrics from MPRIS-enabled browsers, including Firefox and Chrome.
settings.font_family.label: Lyrics font
settings.primary_color.label: Original text color
settings.secondary_color.label: Translation color
settings.separator_color.label: Separator color
settings.offset_ms.label: Timing offset (ms; positive means earlier)
settings.experimental_other_platforms.hi: Read MPRIS metadata from supported music services; lyrics still come from the selected lyrics source.
settings.api_mode.label: Lyrics source
settings.api_url.label: API URL template
settings.api_url.hint: Supports {id}, {title}, {artist}, {album} and {duration}; values are URL-encoded automatically.
settings.lyric_path.label: JSON original lyrics field
settings.lyric_path.hint: For example: lrc.lyric or syncedLyrics. Not needed for APIs returning plain LRC text.
settings.translation_path.label: JSON translation field
settings.translation_path.hint: For example: tlyric.lyric. Leave blank if there is no translation.
desktop.name: NetEase desktop lyrics
desktop.description: Independent desktop lyrics with free positioning, resizing and position locking.
settings.show_translation.label: Show translation
settings.show_romanization.label: Show romanization
settings.show_context.label: Show previous and next lines
settings.romanization_path.label: Romanization field
settings.romanization_path.hint: Path to synchronized romanization LRC in a custom API response. Hidden when unavailable.
settings.lyric_font_size.label: Current line font size
settings.text_align.label: Lyric alignment
settings.show_furigana.label: Japanese furigana
settings.show_furigana.hint: Show kana above kanji using the song’s romanization; keep original text when alignment is uncertain.
settings.romanization_fallback.label: Find missing romanization online
settings.romanization_fallback.hint: When romanization or furigana is enabled, look up missing readings on LRCLIB using song metadata and validate alignment; original lyrics remain visible.
settings.show_progress.label: Show playback progress
settings.show_spectrum.label: Show audio spectrum
